office_does: A Court of Appeals judge reviews trial-court decisions on appeal; Division III, District 2 elects one judge from Adams, Asotin, Benton, Columbia, Franklin, Garfield, Grant, Walla Walla and Whitman counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Tyson R. Hill, appointed by Gov. Ferguson effective Jan. 1, 2026 to replace retiring Judge George Fearing, is the only candidate for the remaining two years of the term.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge since his appointment effective Jan. 1, 2026; previously a Grant County Superior Court and District Court judge. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed by Gov. Ferguson to replace retiring Judge George Fearing, effective Jan. 1, 2026 [S4]
More than 12 years as a Grant County District and Superior Court judge; co-founded Grant County's first therapeutic drug court [S1][S4]
Former lead appellate prosecutor and law clerk to Justice James M. Johnson [S1][S4]
